task.title: Allocating vacation pay that is paid on an anniversary date or at the client’s request

step.cmd: Determine if the monies will be allocated on a claim that meets one of the following conditions:

ul.li: For an initial claim, the BPC is between September 27, 2020 (w/c 2258) and September 19, 2021 (w/c 2309).

The monies are declared on or after September 27, 2020 and would otherwise have been allocated between September 27, 2020 (w/c 2258) and September 25, 2021 (w/c 2309).
In no, go to step 2.
If yes, go to step 22.

step.cmd: Allocate the vacation pay as follows:

ul.li: Determine the anniversary date.
Divide the vacation pay by the NWE. The result is the number of weeks for the allocation.
Take the number of full weeks of allocation and multiply that number by the NWE.
Subtract this amount from the total vacation pay received.
If necessary, the balance is allocated on the last week.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number on file:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 5.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
Under the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 5.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction to input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

On the first line, do the following:
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the NWE.
Start date: Enter the first week of the allocation.
End date: Enter the last week of the allocation.
Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the last week of allocation is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Summary tab, determine if there is a stop pay related to these earnings and do one of the following:

ul.li: If no, go to step 7.

If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and remove the stop payment as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA .
Rescind: Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the allocation must also be input on a blocked claim:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 8.
If no, go to step 19.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 9.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 4.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 10.
If all rows are blank, go to step 12.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter [the next business day].

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 10.
If all rows are blank, go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised (or 2 - Renewal , if necessary).
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the amount allocated per week.
Start date: Enter the start date of the allocation.
End date: Enter the end date of the allocation.

Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the allocation amount in the last week is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation / holiday pay was not deducted .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 15.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 19.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the vacation pay.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .

Remarks line 1: Type “Input M175 V-$XXXX (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), $XXX (amount to be allocated on last week if different).” Example of transaction: V-$700-2389-2392-$400
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocations of Earnings (2516): Select the appropriate option:
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1 - Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 + ROE #2

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
